earlier_scan.source_named: Ferreira, Vera. 2011. Eine dokumentationslinguistische Beschreibung des Minderico (documentary-linguistic description); no online copy located.

sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing on phonology; used only for the bibliography (adds Endruschat & Ferreira 2007; Martins et al. 1993/2004 Piação dos Charales do Ninhou; Ferreira 2011 Meidenbauer chapter with pages 143-170).

sources.citation: CIDLeS (Centro Interdisciplinar de Documentação Linguística e Social). Project pages 'Minderico' and 'Bilingual Dictionary Piação-Portuguese' (cidles.eu, the Internet Archive 2023 copies; live site gone).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Prose only: Minderico 'turned into a full-fledged language.. with a very characteristic intonation and a complex morphosyntax'. Dictionary page says entries carry 'informação etimológica, fonética, gramatical' but no phonology is given online.

sources.citation: Ferreira, Vera. 2016. New speakers of Minderico: Dynamics and tensions in the revitalization process. In V. Ferreira & P. Bouda (eds.), Language Documentation and Conservation in Europe (LD&C Special Publication 9), 26-37. Honolulu: University of Hawai'i Press. hdl:10125/24657
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No rule. Says Minderico has 'a very characteristic intonation' (pp. 26, 30) and, pp. 34-35, that traditional speakers accuse new speakers of 'using Portuguese prosody when speaking Minderico' and that 'prosody is one of the most endangered aspects in Minderico; even traditional speakers are losing it, using gradually more Minderico with Portuguese prosody and accentuation'. Implies a Minderico-specific prosody/accentuation exists but gives no stress placement.

sources.citation: Ferreira, Vera. 2011. De código secreto por língua do quotidiano a língua ameaçada. O CIDLeS e a revitalização do minderico. Desafios 44: 36-37 (NERLEI).
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; popular two-page article on origin and revitalization with a small glossary.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2010. Change Request 2010-039 and New Code Request drc (submitted by Vera Ferreira; adopted 2011-05-18). SIL International.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; names, location, sociolinguistic history and a bibliography (Carvalho 1969, Endruschat & Ferreira 2006, 2007, Ferreira & Bouda 2009, Frazão 1939).

sources.citation: Ferreira, Vera & Peter Bouda. 2009. Minderico: an endangered language in Portugal. In P. K. Austin, O. Bond, M. Charette, D. Nathan & P. Sells (eds.), Proceedings of Conference on Language Documentation and Linguistic Theory 2, 95-106. London: SOAS.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Section 3 'Typology of Minderico' (pp. 100-103) lists spoken-language phenomena (passe-partout words, diminutives, epenthesis 'está > tá') and morphosyntax (SVO, agreement, elliptical partitive constructions, periphrastic verbs); no phonology or stress is discussed. downloaded from the Internet Archive copy of hrelp.org/publications/ldlt2/papers/.

sources.citation: DoBeS project page 'Minderico' (dobes.mpi.nl/projects/minderico/); Glottolog 5.3 languoid page mind1263.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing; DoBeS corpus (64 sessions, 700 audio) is archived at TLA, which currently blocks anonymous access; no sketch grammar is exposed online. Glottolog lists no grammar/phonology doctype for the language.
